'''Nikambree''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who performed extensive modifications to an [[Unidentified R2 unit (Nikambree)|R2-series astromech droid]], to the point that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] did not resemble its original form.
